test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Four sentences are given, out of which three have spelling errors. Choose the sentence with all correctly spelt words.

options.text: They also show problem behaviours, like physical aggression and cheating.
They were meant, she says, to be "a public display of your allegaince."
This guide offers sugestions of capital interest to travelers.
They fly around like nobody's buisness.

solution:
The correct answer is "**They also show problem behaviours, like physical aggression and cheating."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, the Option 1 has all correctly spelled words.
 
• In option 2, "allegiance" is misspelled as "allegaince."
 
• In option 3, "suggestions" is misspelled as "sugestions" and "capital" is misspelled as "interest."
 
• In option 4, "business" is misspelled as "buisness."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: "Allegiance" is the correct spelling, not "allegaince" which means support for a leader, government, belief, etc.(निष्ठा)
 
• Option 3: "Suggestions" is the correct spelling, not "sugestions" which means a plan or idea that somebody mentions for somebody else to discuss and consider.(सुझाव)
 
 
• "Capital" is correctly spelled but used incorrectly in the sentence.
 
 
 
• Option 4: "Business" is the correct spelling, not "buisness" which means an organization or enterprising entity engaged in commercial, industrial, or professional activities. (व्यापार)
